canonical_statement: Let Omega1 and Omega2 be bounded open subsets of Euclidean space with Omega1 contained in Omega2. For every positive eigenvalue index k for which the variational Dirichlet spectra are defined, lambda_k(Omega2) is at most lambda_k(Omega1).
domain_and_universes: Provisional: bounded open sets Omega1 Omega2 in Euclidean space; positive spectral index k; real-valued variational eigenvalues.
hypotheses: both domains satisfy the conditions needed for the discrete variational Dirichlet spectrum
excluded_interpretations: comparison of eigenvalues of two unrelated differential operators
Cheng comparison on Riemannian manifolds (the adjacent THM-M-1324 target)
boundary_cases: Equality is permitted. Empty or non-bounded domains and index k = 0 are outside the provisional root until conventions are fixed.
